title: Claude host installs the shared .agents skill copy, legacy .claude copies are reported and removed only on an explicit command, and this repository drops its .claude copy
description: Claude host installs the shared .agents skill copy, legacy .claude copies are reported and removed only on an explicit command, and this repository drops its .claude copy
acceptance_criteria: `chough init --host claude` and `chough skill update --host claude` write only the shared `.agents/skills/chough-workflow/` copy, and a request naming both claude and openai installs one copy, not two
`chough skill status` and `chough skill update` report an installed `.claude/skills/chough-workflow/` copy as legacy and never delete, update or rewrite it; `chough init` never deletes it

`chough skill remove-legacy --host claude` removes only legacy files byte-identical to the current or a known earlier bundle, keeps edited or unknown files, and refuses with nothing removed when the shared `.agents` copy is missing

This repository has no `.claude` skill copy, `CLAUDE.md` routes Claude Code to `AGENTS.md` and the shared copy, and `docs/integrations.md` states that Claude Code 2.1.316 did not discover `.agents/skills` alone
codex, cursor, gemini and grok keep their existing directories; fmt, lint, the full test suite and `fledge lanes run verify` pass

answers.constraints: AGENTS.md: preserve existing files and others' edits; never delete a user's edited copy. Leif 2026-11-03 8:27 AM MT chose 'Remove .claude entirely' knowing Claude Code 2.1.316 did not discover .agents/skills alone; only the claude host is remapped
